character.description: The same young adult man anime protagonist in every shot: wind-brushed sandy hair, soft silver eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult body proportions. They are a solitary ranch hand watching the moon rise over the endless pampas. Fixed costume: a weathered brown gaucho poncho, cream shirt, dark riding trousers, and tall boots. Signature tool or keepsake: a small silver mate gourd with a leather strap. Maintain the exact same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, proportions, costume silhouette, and signature object across the complete music video.
consistency_rules: One clearly defined protagonist leads this theme from beginning to end.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions in every scene.
Preserve the signature outfit, its color identity, and the defining tool or keepsake.
Do not redesign, replace, or multiply the lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require another person.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in moonlit pampas field, wooden veranda with offerings, hillside path in autumn night; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with moon gold, silver grass, deep indigo, autumn amber; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by wide shot of a giant moon over a field, slow tracking through tall pampas plumes, close-up of dango and susuki on a veranda; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
